# Math League

> A comprehensive platform for organizing and participating in math competitions across elementary, middle, and high school divisions with regional and national championship structures.

Math League hosts competitive math contests and challenges for students nationwide, including ARML team participation and specialized events like the Number Sense Challenge and Relay Challenge. The organization provides detailed information on eligibility, rules, registration, and competition formats across multiple grade levels.

## Key Topics

- Math competitions
- Student eligibility
- Contest registration
- Elementary school division
- Middle school division
- High school division
- ARML teams
- Number Sense Challenge
- Relay Challenge
- Competition rules
- Championship structure
- Test descriptions
- Learning resources
- Regional competitions
- National championships

## Getting Started

- [Homepage](https://mathleague.org): Homepage for Math League with contests, ARML teams, and learning resources
- [About Math League](https://mathleague.org/about.php): About page describing Math League organization and competition structure
- [Why Participate](https://mathleague.org/why.php): Overview of why students should participate in Math League competitions
- [Find a Contest](https://mathleague.org/contestfind.php): Contest finder and directory for locating Math League competitions

## Competition Divisions

- [Elementary School Division](https://mathleague.org/es.php): Elementary school Math League overview, rules, and registration
- [Elementary School Tests](https://mathleague.org/estests.php): Elementary school test descriptions and competition format overview
- [Elementary School Championship](https://mathleague.org/eschampionship.php): Elementary school championship structure and qualification levels
- [Middle School Division](https://mathleague.org/ms.php): Middle school Math League overview, tests, and championship information
- [Middle School Tests](https://mathleague.org/mstests.php): Middle school test descriptions and competition format details
- [Middle School Championship](https://mathleague.org/mschampionship.php): Middle school championship structure and advancement rules
- [High School Division](https://mathleague.org/hs.php): High school Math League contests, challenges, and registration info
- [High School Tests](https://mathleague.org/hstests.php): High school test descriptions and competition format guidelines
- [High School Championship](https://mathleague.org/hschampionship.php): High school championship structure and qualification advancement
- [Early Childhood Division](https://mathleague.org/ec.php): Early childhood Math League contest information and navigation

## Special Competitions

- [Number Sense Challenge](https://mathleague.org/nschallenge.php): Number Sense Challenge competition for high school students
- [Relay Challenge](https://mathleague.org/relaychallenge.php): Relay Challenge team event for elementary, middle, and high school
